描述_EN: a fragment of the linen ground cloth in which the square was sewn remains. stitching thread and lines of fringe adorn the fragment. grand square fragment bearing a stylized plant design, the details of which are enhanced with a flying shuttle. the overall frame is formed by a frieze of posts and a thin monochrome band. the central decoration appears in a circle inscribed in the square, whose spandrels are occupied by trifoliate vine leaves with scrolls.
描述_ZN: 保留了缝制方块的亚麻底布的碎片。 缝纫线和流苏线装饰了这个片段。 零碎的大广场，有风格化的植物装饰，其中的细节以飞梭来加强。 整体框架是由柱子的门楣和薄薄的单色带构成。 中央装饰出现在一个刻在广场上的圆圈中，圆圈的边框被带卷轴的三叶藤叶占据。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
